name: helix-discord-bot
description: HELIX Universal Discord Bot & AI Dashboard with self-contained zero-cost SQLite database

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Discord Bot Token from Discord Developer Portal

DISCORD_CALLBACK_URL.description: Base OAuth2 URL (leave empty or set to your Heroku app URL)

NEXT_PUBLIC_INVITE_URL.description: Administrator Discord bot invite URL with permissions=8 and scope=bot

NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Public URL of your Heroku app (e.g. https://your-app-name.herokuapp.com)

NEXTAUTH_INTERNAL_URL.description: Internal connection URL (defaults to http://localhost, dashboard auto-binds port)

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: HMAC secret for signing NextAuth sessions (generate a 32+ char string)
